headline: Culture grows faster than the Mexican economy
summary: INEGI reported that culture generated 913,088 million pesos in 2025, or 2.7% of GDP, and created 1,443,403 jobs, or 3.5% of national employment.
why: INEGI is Mexico's national statistics agency, and its sector data shape how policymakers and investors view non-traditional parts of the economy.
original_headline: La cultura crece más que la economía mexicana
